findings.explanation: Payment is due 90 days after your invoice, which significantly delays receipt of your earnings.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a small adjustment before we move forward. - Regarding the relevant clause, payment is due 90 days after your invoice, which significantly delays receipt of your earnings, and I propose that we change this so that invoices are payable Net 30. Let me know if this works for you.
